scope: Empirical evaluation of finite-history storage; no novelty or overall-rendering-speed claim
sparse_native_pilot_policy: If median exceeds 50ms, report feasibility failure relative to the 20Hz capture budget; do not launch expensive repeated-throughput runs. Preserve all pilot durations. This does not establish statistical equivalence or general impossibility.
precision_equivalence_policy: No predeclared perceptual equivalence margin; report numerical error and Pareto fronts, no matched-fidelity significance claim
